p.scope-of-this-document: **Scope of this document.** This file is the operational responsibility table derived from the two-process model: *which* work belongs to which process, *where* both participate and in what shape, and *what follows* from the one asymmetry that dominates everything — the AI has no memory between sessions.

human-only.title: Only the human (the AI can, but badly)

facts.HUMAN-ONLY-MEANING-AND-ITS-CONNECTION-TO: Thinking about the project at the level of meaning and its connection to reality.
facts.HUMAN-ONLY-ARCHITECTURE-AT-THE-LEVEL-OF-: Architectural decisions at the level of intent.
facts.HUMAN-ONLY-SENSING-WRONG-BEHAVIOUR-BEFOR: Sensing that "the system behaves wrong" before any test says so.
facts.HUMAN-ONLY-DECIDING-WHEN-A-SPECIFICATION: Deciding when a specification is stale.
facts.HUMAN-ONLY-TALKING-TO-USERS: Talking to users; understanding what they need.

ai-only.title: Only the AI (the human can, but wastefully)

facts.AI-ONLY-ARCHITECTURE-AT-THE-LEVEL-OF-SMA: Architectural decisions at the level of small detail.
facts.AI-ONLY-GENERATING-LARGE-CONSISTENT-VOLU: Generating large volumes of mutually consistent code in minutes.
facts.AI-ONLY-RECALLING-THE-EXACT-SYNTAX-OF-A-: Recalling the exact syntax of a thousand APIs.
facts.AI-ONLY-MECHANICAL-REFACTORS-ACROSS-THE-: Mechanical refactors across the whole codebase where the IDE gives up.
facts.AI-ONLY-FORMAL-CHECKS: Formal checks: does it build, does it lint, is it formatted.
facts.AI-ONLY-HOLDING-EVERY-DETAIL-OF-A-FILE: Holding every detail of a file simultaneously (within the context window).

td.ROW-WRITING-SPECS-HUMAN-CONTRIBUTES: the idea and the decision; approves the final text

td.ROW-CODE-REVIEW-HUMAN-CONTRIBUTES: semantics — does it do what was *meant*

td.ROW-CODE-REVIEW-AI-CONTRIBUTES: formal properties — builds, tests pass, lint is clean

td.ROW-DEBUGGING-AI-CONTRIBUTES: evidence collection (logs, traces, live probing) and hypothesis testing

td.ROW-DOCUMENTATION-AI-CONTRIBUTES: generates the update from the diff

p.THE-AI-HAS-NO-MEMORY-BETWEEN-SESSIONS: **The AI has no memory between sessions. None.**

p.EVERY-SESSION-IS-A-NEW-PROCESS: Every session is a new process that knows nothing of the previous ones.

p.imagine-a-developer-who-never-returns: Imagine a brilliant developer who arrives every morning, works, leaves in the evening — and never returns.

p.tomorrow-a-different-one-arrives: Tomorrow a different one arrives, equally brilliant, with zero recollection of your project.

p.WHATEVER-THE-DOCUMENTATION-SAYS-IS-ALL-T: Whatever the documentation says is all the new arrival knows.

p.a-stale-doc-yields-the-old-hash-function: If you switched hash functions yesterday and did not update the docs, today's developer uses the old one.

p.BLAKE3-ALONE-IS-A-FACT: "We use blake3" is a fact — recoverable from the code in a second.

p.BLAKE3-WITH-ITS-REASON-IS-A-DECISION: "We use blake3 because SHA-256 drags in a dependency we cannot afford on edge hardware" is a decision — unrecoverable from anywhere once forgotten.

p.RECORD-DECISIONS-THE-FIRST-KIND-RECORDS-: Record the second kind; the first kind records itself.

p.human-teams-survive-on-tribal-knowledge: Human teams survive on tribal knowledge because Vasya can be asked.

p.KNOWLEDGE-NOT-IN-A-FILE-DOES-NOT-EXIST-F: Knowledge that is not in a file the AI can read does not exist for the AI — and the AI will decide *without* it, confidently.

p.WRITE-EVERY-DECISION-DOWN: Every time a decision is made, write it down; not because you will forget (though you will), but because the AI never knew.

window.title: The context window is finite working memory

p.THE-WINDOW-HOLDS-EVERYTHING: The window holds the specs, the code, the conversation — everything.

p.LONG-SESSIONS-PUSH-EARLY-CONTENT-INTO-TH: Long sessions push early content into the zone the attention mechanism effectively ignores ("lost in the middle"): technically present, statistically unread.

p.SHORT-SESSIONS-BEAT-LONG-ONES-AND-CONSTR: Consequences: **short sessions beat long ones** (five sessions of thirty minutes outperform one of two and a half hours), and critical constraints belong at the start or end of any document, never buried in its middle (see flow:addressable-specs).

p.write-specs-for-the-ai-is-half-the-truth: "Write specs for the AI" is half the truth.

p.you-will-not-remember-and-the-teammate-n: In two months *you* will not remember why the timeout is 600 seconds; the new teammate never knew.

p.WRITE-EVERY-LOAD-BEARING-FILE-FOR-THREE-: Write every load-bearing file for three readers at once — the AI's next session, your future self, the next human — from one source.

p.TEXT-THAT-WORKS-FOR-THE-AI-WORKS-FOR-THE: Text that works for the AI carries the other two most of the way, though not for free: where a reader needs a different shape — the human's end-of-session scan against the checkpoint the next session reads — the cost is a second rendering of the one source, never a second source.

p.ASK-WHETHER-THE-WORK-IS-BOUNDED-MECHANIC: Before assigning any piece of work, ask: *is this bounded, mechanical, and verifiable by a formal check?*

p.IF-YES-IT-GOES-TO-THE-AI-WHOLE: If yes, it goes to the AI whole.

p.ASK-WHETHER-IT-NEEDS-MEMORY-TASTE-OR-A-L: *Does it require memory of why, taste, or a decision that outlives the session?*

p.IF-YES-THE-HUMAN-DECIDES-AND-MAY-DELEGAT: If yes, the human does the deciding — and may still delegate the typing.

facts.SUM-THREE-ZONES: Three zones: human-only (meaning, coherence, decisions), AI-only (throughput, mechanics, formal checks), and shared work split by nature, not by halves.
facts.SUM-ZERO-CROSS-SESSION-MEMORY-DOMINATES: The AI's zero cross-session memory dominates the design: record decisions, treat unwritten knowledge as nonexistent, keep sessions short, write every file for AI + future-you + the next human at once.
facts.SUM-DELEGATE-MECHANICAL-WORK-KEEP-DECISI: Delegate bounded mechanical work whole; keep decisions human even when delegating their typing.
